title: How Long Do You Have Left To Live?
summary: Built for the long game or living for the plot? Discover your clock personality and a just-for-fun age estimate.

landing.intro:
10 quick questions.
What age is hiding in your answers?

about.body:
Discover what your everyday habits say about your life clock.

Your result is a playful age estimate and lifestyle profile, not a medical prediction or a reliable estimate of life expectancy.

steps: Choose the answer that feels most like your real routine without overthinking it.
Complete all ten lifestyle questions in one uninterrupted run.

about.disclaimer: For entertainment and self-reflection only. This quiz does not predict lifespan, health, mortality risk or medical outcomes. If you have health concerns, speak to a qualified healthcare professional.

stage-1.preAdCopy: Your age estimate and lifestyle profile are ready to reveal.

centenarian_energy.title: The Long-Game Legend
centenarian_energy.copy: You make small promises and actually keep them. Your answers favour repeatable habits, room to recover and choices that tomorrow-you will appreciate. Your signature: quietly playing the long game.

steady_long_game.title: Steady By Nature
steady_long_game.copy: You know the value of a routine that feels like yours. Familiar rituals and dependable people give your days their shape. Your signature: being the person others can count on, without making a big production of it.

balanced_realist.title: The Balanced Realist
balanced_realist.copy: You make room for sensible choices and a life worth enjoying. Your answers adapt to the day instead of chasing a perfect routine. Your signature: knowing when to stick to the plan and when to order the cake.

weekend_chaos.title: The Weekend Wildcard
weekend_chaos.copy: Your best stories rarely begin with a strict plan. Your answers lean toward spontaneous moments, good company and the occasional negotiation with tomorrow-you. Your signature: turning an ordinary evening into a story.

stress_sprinter.title: The Full-Speed Soul
stress_sprinter.copy: You bring momentum to almost everything. Your answers often put the next task ahead of the next pause. Your signature: getting things moving. A little more breathing room could make that pace feel more like a choice.

comfort_creature.title: Comfort Royalty
comfort_creature.copy: You know exactly what makes a day feel good: familiar places, favourite people and a proper chance to switch off. Your signature: making ordinary life feel welcoming. There is skill in knowing what suits you.

adventure_fuse.title: The Plot Chaser
adventure_fuse.copy: Curiosity gets a vote in your decisions. Your answers find possibility in new places, odd ideas and days that take an unexpected turn. Your signature: coming back with a story nobody saw coming.

reset_needed.title: The Comeback Chapter
reset_needed.copy: Your answers often ask for more room, fewer demands and a chance to catch your breath. Your signature right now: wanting a fresh start that fits real life. Your clock type is a snapshot of these choices, not a permanent label.

reviewUnlock.title: Which choices shaped your clock?
reviewUnlock.copy: Go behind the number: see which of your answers moved the playful estimate up, down or kept it steady.
reviewUnlock.adNote: One short ad, then see what shaped your estimate.
reviewUnlock.raisedCopy: This answer added an upward lifestyle signal to the estimate.
reviewUnlock.loweredCopy: This answer added a downward lifestyle signal to the estimate.
reviewUnlock.neutralCopy: This answer added context without meaningfully moving the estimate.

estimate.disclaimer: For entertainment only. This is not a medical or life-expectancy prediction.

yl-s1q1.question: Your alarm goes off. Which version of you shows up?

answers.a3: Up with enough time to take it slowly

yl-s2q1.question: Breakfast is calling. What usually answers?

answers.a3: Something different if I have time
answers.a4: I keep forgetting until I am running on empty

yl-s3q4.question: Your favourite way to move is...

answers.a1: Something I can make a regular habit
answers.a2: A familiar activity at my own pace
answers.a4: Something social, with music if possible

yl-s4q1.question: It is bedtime. Your phone has other ideas. Who wins?

answers.a1: The phone. One video became twenty.
answers.a4: I am still replying to things

yl-s5q6.question: Who notices first when you are doing too much?

answers.a1: Me, before the whole week fills up
answers.a4: Usually me, after I hit a wall

answers.a1: The usual place with my usual people
answers.a2: An activity neither of us has tried
answers.a3: A quick chat that becomes a whole evening

yl-s7q1.question: A new habit survives for a week, then slips. You...

answers.a2: Wait for my motivation to return
answers.a3: Adjust it so it fits my real life

yl-s8q3.question: What makes you lose track of time in a good way?

answers.a2: A hobby I have loved for years
answers.a3: Talking and laughing with my people
answers.a4: A familiar activity that lets me switch off

yl-s9q3.question: A worthwhile change will take months. Your approach?

answers.a1: Start small enough to keep going
answers.a3: Fit it around the life I already have
answers.a4: Wait for the right moment to begin

yl-s10q7.question: Last instinct: how does your next chapter feel?

answers.a1: I need a pause before I can picture it
answers.a3: I am finding a pace that works for me
answers.a4: I am building habits I want to grow with
